priceSnapshot.note: Against the midnight mark of 64,849.7 the tape is DOWN 299.8 points, or 0.46%. The morning has been a one-way fade. Price pushed to 64,999.9 on the 08:00Z hour - the fourth rejection of the 65,000 handle inside 30 hours - and has not made a higher high since, grinding down through five consecutive lower hourly closes to 64,549.9. Session range measured since the midnight snapshot (07:15Z onward, from the 15m series, 20 bars): low 64,507.1, high 64,999.9, a 492.8-point band worth 0.33 of a daily ATR. Two things changed inside that range. Price lost the daily EMA50 at 64,661.21, which it was sitting above at midnight, and it lost the whole 15m EMA stack down to the EMA100 at 64,609.92. What it has NOT lost is the 4H structure: price is still above all four 4H EMAs and 453 points above the daily EMA20 at 64,097.32, which is the floor of the reclaim thesis. This is a fade inside the box, not a break of it.

reduceIf.confirmation: A 1H CLOSE below $64,100, which takes out the UTC daily EMA20 at 64,097.32 and the 1h EMA100 at 64,109.58 in one move - those two lines are now 12 points apart, so there is no second chance beneath. The daily EMA20 has held on a closing basis for six consecutive UTC days and is the last structural support of the reclaim. The warnings between spot and it, in order, are the session low at 64,507.1, the 64,500 liquidation shelf, the 06 Aug low at 64,444.4, the 1h EMA50 at 64,393.45, the 15m EMA200 at 64,366.05 and the 4H EMA20 at 64,204.23.

addIf.confirmation: A 4H CLOSE above $65,030, clearing the 24-hour high of 65,026.6 and the 65,000 handle that has now rejected four separate times in 30 hours - 16:15 COT on 05 Aug, 20:00Z, 05:00Z and again at 08:00Z this morning, the last two both stopping within 0.1 of a point of 65,000.0. A wick is not the signal; every one of those four rejections happened intrabar, so only a 4H close counts. Above it the next measured objects are the 31 Jul swing high at 65,423.7, the 20-day high at 66,955.0 and the daily EMA100 at 67,045.52.

decisionBox.changed: Position stays ADD but the reduce line moves down 25 points to 64,100 and confidence comes off from 6.2 to 5.6. Nothing in the structural case broke - the ETF streak is intact and accelerating, the 4H is still above all four EMAs, funding is a token positive and shorts are still being carried out roughly seven to one. What changed is momentum. The 4H MACD histogram has decayed on every reading today, from +100.90 at midnight to +79.52 at 06:47 COT to +56.10 now, while price printed the same 65,000 high twice - that is a textbook bearish momentum divergence and it is recorded in the divergences array. The 1H MACD has crossed bearish outright at -41.67 and 15m RSI is down at 39.31. So the bias drops from bullish to range with a bullish tilt: the box is 64,444 to 65,030 and the tape is at the lower half of it. That is a place to buy a small tranche, not a place to chase.

liquidation.note: $1,990,962 of REALIZED liquidations bucketed into the 64,850-64,950 band, still the single heaviest cluster anywhere on the board and now 350 points ABOVE spot rather than the 50 points it sat above at midnight. Built from 821 filled liquidation orders on the OKX BTC-USDT perp between 2026-08-05T12:06:18Z and 2026-08-06T11:07:27Z, sized as bkPx x sz x 0.01 BTC contract value. This marks where the market has already paid, not a forward heatmap - it is the price band that has been most expensive to be wrong at, and the fact that price has now walked away from it downward is the clearest single sign that this morning's fade is real rather than noise.

$1,457,081 of realized liquidations in the 64,750-64,850 band. It has flipped from support to resistance since midnight, when spot was sitting on top of it. Together with the 64,900 cluster this is a continuous 200-point wall of $3.45M sitting directly over the market - the first thing any recovery has to eat through, and the reason a push back to the handle would be slow rather than clean.

$1,111,751 of realized liquidations in the 64,650-64,750 band, now the nearest cluster above spot at 150 points away. It brackets the daily EMA50 at 64,661.21, the 1h EMA20 at 64,645.61 and the 15m EMA20/50 pair at 64,682.51 and 64,695.59, so reclaiming it means reclaiming four moving averages and a liquidation shelf at the same price. That confluence is what makes 64,700 the honest short-term line between fade and recovery.

$1,062,396 of realized liquidations in the 64,450-64,550 band - the nearest cluster below and the one price is standing on right now. The session low of 64,507.1 tagged the top of it at the 11:00Z hour and held, which is the single piece of evidence supporting a long here. It also brackets the 06 Aug low at 64,444.4. Lose this band on a 1H close and the next measured shelf is 100 points lower and much thinner.

$888,773 of realized liquidations at the 65,000 handle itself. Smaller than the 64,900 cluster below it, which remains the tell: the four pushes into 65,000 have each been repelled before enough leverage could accumulate up there, so the handle is being defended by sellers rather than by a stack of stops.

$527,164 of realized liquidations in the 64,350-64,450 band, roughly half the density of the 64,500 shelf. It sits on the 06 Aug low of 64,444.4, the 1h EMA50 at 64,393.45 and the 15m EMA200 at 64,366.05. This is the last cushion before the 4H EMA20 at 64,204.23 and the air pocket down to the daily EMA20.

liquidityMagnet.note: The mass is above, and by a wide margin: $5.45M of the $7.95M window sits in the four bands from 64,700 to 65,000, against $1.94M in everything below 64,600. On a pure density read that is an upward pull toward the 64,900 magnet. Treat it as a weak signal this morning rather than a strong one, because price is actively walking away from that mass - it has made five consecutive lower hourly closes since the 08:00Z rejection. The honest reading is that the magnet marks where a recovery would have to work hardest, not where the market is being dragged right now.

divergences.note: A flat double top with collapsing momentum. The 04:00Z 4H bar topped at 65,000.0 with the histogram at +100.90 as read by the midnight session; the 08:00Z bar topped at 64,999.9, one tenth of a point lower, and the histogram has since fallen to +56.10 - a 44% decay in momentum for an identical high. calibration.note: The midnight call was bullish with a 64,125 reduce level and a 65,030 add level. Neither fired: the session low of 64,507.1 stayed 382 points clear of the reduce line and the high of 64,999.9 missed the add trigger by 30 points, which is about as close as a level gets without printing. So the levels themselves were well placed. Acting did not help, though - midnight bought 12 USDT of spot at 64,849.7 and price is now 299.8 lower at 64,549.9, an unrealised drag of roughly 0.46% on that tranche. That is the fourth consecutive session marked not-helped and the pattern behind all four is the same: buying into the 64,800-65,000 shelf, which the liquidation map has been flagging as the heaviest overhead band all week. The lesson is being applied this morning by buying 300 points lower and by holding back the rest of the cash for the 64,100 line.
